text:
morgan: Heads-up — during the staged publish for Python/TS SDK we saw intermittent npm 401s from the CI runner when pushing dist-tag `next`. Py wheel upload succeeded.
release-bot: [deploy] npm publish: package @redwood/sdk-js 0.7.3 -> FAILED (401 Unauthorized) - ci-22
release-bot: [deploy] wheel upload: redwood-sdk-py 0.7.3 -> SUCCESS
jess: :eyes: do we retry or yank the dist-tag? We can't have partial availability for customers.
sam: If the npm restore fails again, fallback plan is to retag to `canary` and republish later. But for safety I'm leaning toward rollback of the JS artifact now.
morgan: +1. My call: hold the JS release. Rollback criteria proposed: any publish failure that affects >1 artifact OR any registry 401/403 during CI publish -> full cross-lang pause.
lee: Also reminder: we have embargoed changelog text for the sync-client deprecation. We need to update release notes to reflect the pause and keep the embargo intact until 2024-10-15 as discussed.
jess: Rollback steps I suggest: 1) remove `next` dist-tag -> `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-js next 0.7.3`; 2) set `canary` (or retarget `next`) to 0.7.2; 3) open republish ticket after creds rotation.
morgan: I'll run the rollback. @release-bot can you run `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-js next` from the release runner?
release-bot: ack: running `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-js next` from ci-22 (token: release-service)
release-bot: stdout: removed dist-tag 'next' from @redwood/sdk-js@0.7.3
release-bot: note: package still resolvable by exact version, tags removed so no ephemeral 'next' traffic
sam: :thumbsup: Good. Also let's pin internal examples and the docs-site to 0.7.2 until we have a verified republish. I'll do a quick grep/replace in the docs repo.
lee: I'll update the release notes draft: short blurb "JS rollout paused due to registry auth; users should pin to 0.7.2 or use CDN fallback" + link to internal bug #447 and the embargo label.
morgan: Action items captured: (morgan) open creds rotation ticket and coordinate with infra; (dev-bot) block automated release attempts for sdk-js; (jess) update pinned versions doc and add rollback steps; (lee) update release notes and add embargoed note. No further publishes in quiet window until creds rotation completes.
dev-bot: Automated release scheduling paused for project `sdk-js` until 2024-10-16 or manual resume by a repo admin.
jess: Left a short note in the release playbook: `docs/release.md` -> added rollback criteria and dist-tag fallback examples (commands included).
morgan: Thanks team. Closing this thread unless anyone has objections.
sam: One more note — if we need an emergency hotpatch for a security fix, ops-runbook has steps for signed tarball upload to the CDN as a last resort.
morgan: Noted. Will include that path in the republish checklist.
